verdict.rationale: Jules has a documented official API for building against it: API keys, creating sessions and workflows, sending messages to the agent, approving plans, and an `automationMode` setting. A community user also built an MCP server on top of that API. However, nothing in the evidence shows an official SDK or client library, so developers must work directly against the raw API; probes for an OpenAPI spec on jules.google also returned 404. Missing for 10: official language SDKs/client libraries, a published machine-readable API spec, and SDK documentation or examples.
